adjustment_notes_invoice.name: adjustment_notes_invoice
adjustment_notes_invoice.value: ("adjustment_notes"."kind" in ('sales_credit', 'sales_debit') and "adjustment_notes"."purchase_invoice_id" is null) or ("adjustment_notes"."kind" in ('purchase_debit', 'purchase_credit') and "adjustment_notes"."sales_invoice_id" is null and "adjustment_notes"."payable_account_id" is not null)

contract_rates_method_refs.name: contract_rates_method_refs
contract_rates_method_refs.value:
case "contract_rates"."method"
        when 'per_km_vehicle_type' then "contract_rates"."vehicle_type_id" is not null
        when 'specific_vehicle' then "contract_rates"."vehicle_id" is not null and "contract_rates"."route_id" is not null
        when 'route_fixed' then "contract_rates"."route_id" is not null
        when 'car_transport' then "contract_rates"."route_id" is not null
        when 'per_quantity' then "contract_rates"."unit" is not null
      end

custody_docs_amounts.name: custody_docs_amounts
custody_docs_amounts.value: "custody_docs"."amount" >= 0 and "custody_docs"."quantity" > 0 and "custody_docs"."returned_amount" between 0 and "custody_docs"."amount" and ("custody_docs"."kind" <> 'cash' or "custody_docs"."amount" > 0)

expenses_payer_refs.name: expenses_payer_refs
expenses_payer_refs.value: case "expenses"."payer" when 'driver_custody' then "expenses"."driver_id" is not null when 'cash' then "expenses"."cash_account_id" is not null end

fixed_assets_amounts.name: fixed_assets_amounts
fixed_assets_amounts.value: "fixed_assets"."cost" > 0 and "fixed_assets"."salvage_value" >= 0 and "fixed_assets"."salvage_value" < "fixed_assets"."cost" and "fixed_assets"."useful_life_months" between 1 and 600 and "fixed_assets"."opening_depreciation" >= 0

maintenance_orders_provider_refs.name: maintenance_orders_provider_refs
maintenance_orders_provider_refs.value: case "maintenance_orders"."provider" when 'external' then "maintenance_orders"."supplier_id" is not null when 'internal' then "maintenance_orders"."supplier_id" is null end

payments_kind_refs.name: payments_kind_refs
payments_kind_refs.value: case "payments"."kind" when 'supplier' then "payments"."party_id" is not null when 'custody' then "payments"."driver_id" is not null end

payroll_lines_amounts.name: payroll_lines_amounts
payroll_lines_amounts.value: "payroll_lines"."basic" >= 0 and "payroll_lines"."housing" >= 0 and "payroll_lines"."other_allowances" >= 0 and "payroll_lines"."absence_days" >= 0 and "payroll_lines"."additions" >= 0 and "payroll_lines"."deductions" >= 0 and "payroll_lines"."advance_deduction" >= 0

sales_invoice_lines_refs.name: sales_invoice_lines_refs
sales_invoice_lines_refs.value:
case "sales_invoice_lines"."kind"
        when 'waybill' then "sales_invoice_lines"."waybill_id" is not null and "sales_invoice_lines"."waybill_expense_id" is null
        when 'expense' then "sales_invoice_lines"."waybill_expense_id" is not null
        else "sales_invoice_lines"."waybill_id" is null and "sales_invoice_lines"."waybill_expense_id" is null
      end

stock_docs_transfer.name: stock_docs_transfer
stock_docs_transfer.value: ("stock_docs"."kind" = 'transfer') = ("stock_docs"."to_warehouse_id" is not null) and ("stock_docs"."to_warehouse_id" is null or "stock_docs"."to_warehouse_id" <> "stock_docs"."warehouse_id")

vehicle_assignments_odometer.name: vehicle_assignments_odometer
vehicle_assignments_odometer.value: "vehicle_assignments"."odometer_end" is null or "vehicle_assignments"."odometer_start" is null or "vehicle_assignments"."odometer_end" >= "vehicle_assignments"."odometer_start"

waybills_execution_refs.name: waybills_execution_refs
waybills_execution_refs.value:
case "waybills"."execution"
        when 'fleet' then "waybills"."vehicle_id" is not null and "waybills"."driver_id" is not null and "waybills"."carrier_id" is null
        when 'carrier' then "waybills"."carrier_id" is not null and "waybills"."vehicle_id" is null and "waybills"."driver_id" is null
      end

waybills_odometer.name: waybills_odometer
waybills_odometer.value: "waybills"."odometer_end" is null or "waybills"."odometer_start" is null or "waybills"."odometer_end" >= "waybills"."odometer_start"
